label: Dependence order-law controls for the priority bridges
paraphrase: Mathematical controls on Fin 3 and Fin 2. (1) A reflexive direct-edge chain (2 depends on 1, 1 depends on 0, but 2 not on 0) satisfies distinct nonmutuality and both priority bridges when simple priority is read as the strict part of D, yet neither D nor that priority is transitive. (2) A reflexive, transitive D with one reciprocal pair violates distinct nonmutuality and has an empty strict part. Formal interpretations only.
